description: Before you add or upgrade dependencies, especially to a release newer than your training data: give the packages and the versions you are about to install. For each one, Cairn answers from its verdict records: status known_problem (reproduced by Cairn), known_problem_computed (from registry metadata, not run), fixed, or no record, with a record of fields: kind, forced_install (does forcing the install work), safe_pin (a pin Cairn tested; verified records only), fixed_in, stale. A package is matched as the release or as the partner that refuses it. Also the release date and the latest release. No record is not a safety claim.

name.description: Registry name, for example typescript or pydantic.

version.description: The version you are about to install; omit for the latest.

name: cairn_check_dependencies
title: Check dependencies before installing
